Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Madman2001 wrote:
>
> Dear Older Vampires:
>
> The Discipline Master cards only specify that they be played on a
> vampire. Therefore, I wonder if they could be played on a vampire in
> torpor. How about an uncontrolled vampire??

Torpor: yes.
Uncontrolled: no.

Cards that target other cards can only target *controlled* cards, by
default. Explicit card text is needed to target cards that are not
controlled.
